earnings.title: First Fiscal Quarter 2027
highlights: Revenue as a percentage of GMV was 8.79%, above the high end of our 7.5% to 8.5% medium term range, and an increase of 11 basis points compared to FQ1’26.
Operating Income as a % of Revenue 27% +4 pp Total Revenue as a % of GMV 8.8% RLTC as a % of GMV 4.3% +7 bps Operating Income $187M +194% All comparisons on a year-over-year basis +11 bps Adj.

As a percent of GMV, network revenue declined 24 basis points due to the aforementioned growth in D2C GMV. • Interest income grew 45%, slightly above the 38% increase in average net loans held for investment and above overall GMV growth.
